desc: Save one or more images to a tar archive (streamed to STDOUT by default)
u: docker-save - Save one or more images to a tar archive (streamed to STDOUT by default)

-o, --output
="" Write to a file, instead of STDOUT
--platform
=[] Save only the given platform(s). Formatted as a comma-separated list of "os[/arch[/variant]]" (e.g., "linux/amd64,linux/arm64/v8")
